skills.name: emil-design-eng
skills.trigger: Substantial design-critical web UI implementation or refinement that needs high-craft composition, interaction, and restraint.

skills.name: animate
skills.trigger: Implement one justified animation after its purpose, properties, interruption behavior, and reduced-motion fallback are known.

skills.name: review-animations
skills.trigger: Review animation code or a motion-heavy diff against strict motion standards.

skills.name: improve-animations
skills.trigger: Audit an existing codebase's animation system and produce a read-only, implementation-ready improvement plan.

skills.name: find-animation-opportunities
skills.trigger: Find a small number of missing, purposeful motion opportunities; reject decorative candidates.

skills.name: animation-vocabulary
skills.trigger: Name or classify a motion effect so design and engineering share precise vocabulary.

skills.name: apple-design
skills.trigger: The approved direction specifically calls for tactile gestures, spring physics, fluid materials, or Apple-platform conventions.

skills.name: prototype
skills.trigger: A human explicitly asks for multiple genuinely different live variants and will choose before production changes.

skills.name: pick-ui-library
skills.trigger: A human explicitly requests a dependency recommendation after installed project capabilities have been inspected.

skills.name: ask-sonner
skills.trigger: The project already uses Sonner or the approved task is specifically about Sonner setup or troubleshooting.
